start.title: [TODO:pt-BR] A Question Burns
start.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You see Jesus on the road.
A question burns inside you.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Run past, too proud to ask

pride_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Do Not Walk On
pride_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The question will not leave you.
Go and ask him.

eternal_life.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Good Teacher
eternal_life.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You kneel. "What must I do
to inherit eternal life?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Truth is not bought with haste.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Boast of your good deeds first

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Be Still
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Eternal things ask quiet hearts.
Wait and listen.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Listen First
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Boasting closes the ear.
Let him speak.

commandments.title: [TODO:pt-BR] You Know Them
commandments.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "Do not kill, steal, or lie.
Honor your father and mother."

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Brush them off as too easy

easy_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Weigh Them
easy_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The commandments are not small.
Receive them again.

claim.title: [TODO:pt-BR] All My Life
claim.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "All these I have kept
since I was a boy."

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] He looks at you and loves you.

lie_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Be Honest
lie_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He sees the corners of your soul.
Speak the truth.

challenge.title: [TODO:pt-BR] One Thing You Lack
challenge.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "Sell what you own, give to
the poor, and follow me."

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Argue that wealth is a gift
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Gifts are meant to be shared.
[TODO:pt-BR] He asked for all of you.

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Do Not Argue
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He is not asking to take.
He is offering freedom.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Sit with the weight of his words

bargain_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Half a heart cannot follow him.
He asks for all.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Sit with the weight of his words

conflict.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Heart Weighs
conflict.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Your gold feels heavy in your hand.
Your soul feels heavier.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Open your hands to let go

surrender_path.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Almost
surrender_path.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You almost let go.
But the weight is too great.

walk_away.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Sorrowful
walk_away.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You turn away, deeply sad.
Your wealth holds you back.

forget_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Do Not Forget
forget_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] His eyes still find you.
Remember what you felt.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Carry his words in your heart

teaching.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Hard for the Rich
teaching.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "How hard for the rich
to enter the kingdom of God."
